pairs: Whoever are servants under the yoke,
dominos suos omni honore dignos arbitrentur,
let them consider their masters to be worthy of every honor,
ne nomen Domini et doctrina blasphemetur.
lest the name and doctrine of the Lord be blasphemed.
But those who have believing masters,
let them not despise them because they are brothers,
sed magis serviant, quia fideles sunt et dilecti,
but rather serve them all the more because they are believing and beloved,
et non acquiescit sanis sermonibus Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
and does not consent to the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ,
et ei, quæ secundum pietatem est, doctrinæ:
and to that doctrine which is in accord with piety,
the conflicts of men who have been corrupted in mind
who consider profit to be piety.
Est autem quæstus magnus pietas cum sufficientia.
But piety with sufficiency is great gain.
Nihil enim intulimus in hunc mundum:
For we brought nothing into this world,
haud dubium quod nec auferre quid possumus.
and there is no doubt that we can take nothing away.
having nourishment and some kind of covering,
we should be content with these.
For those who want to become rich fall into temptation
and into the snare of the devil
quæ mergunt homines in interitum et perditionem.
Radix enim omnium malorum est cupiditas:
For desire is the root of all evils. Some persons,
quam quidam appetentes erraverunt a fide, et inseruerunt se doloribus multis.
hungering in this way, have strayed from the faith and have entangled themselves in many sorrows.
Fight the good fight of faith.
apprehende vitam æternam, in qua vocatus es,
Take hold of the eternal life to which you have been called,
et confessus bonam confessionem coram multis testibus.
and make a good profession of faith in the sight of many witnesses.
qui testimonium reddidit sub Pontio Pilato,
and in the sight of Christ Jesus,
who gave the testimony of a good profession under Pontius Pilate,
irreprehensibile usque in adventum Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
immaculately, irreproachably, unto the return of our Lord Jesus Christ.
quem suis temporibus ostendet beatus et solus potens,
he shall reveal the blessed and only Power,
the King of kings and the Lord of lords,
and who inhabits the inaccessible light,
nor even is able to see,
Divitibus hujus sæculi præcipe non sublime sapere,
Instruct the wealthy of this age not to have a superior attitude,
nor to hope in the uncertainty of riches,
sed in Deo vivo (qui præstat nobis omnia abunde ad fruendum)
but in the living God, who offers us everything in abundance to enjoy,
to become rich in good works,
thesaurizare sibi fundamentum bonum in futurum,
to gather for themselves the treasure of a good foundation for the future,
so that they may obtain true life.
guard what has been deposited with you,
avoiding the voice of profane novelties and of opposing ideas,
May grace be with you. Amen.
